light.best.quote: Dendrobiums grow best in bright, indirect light, ideally in a west or south-facing window.

light.directSun.quote: These orchids grow best with bright light to some sun, but no direct midday sun.

temperature.idealC.reason: 出典は種類（高温性・中温性・低温性）によって適温が違うとするため、一般的な室温の範囲とした

humidity.quote: They prefer high humidity, around 60% or more but with good air circulation.

watering.growing.quote: should dry out partially between waterings but never be fully dry

watering.winter.quote: Overwatering when the plant is dormant, or underwatering when the plant is growing can have fatal results.

tips.ja: 光が足りないと花が咲かない。
冬に葉を落とす種類は、晩秋〜初冬に水を控えると花芽がつく。
tips.quote: For these species, withhold water in the late fall and early winter to mimic natural conditions and stimulate blooming.
